response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years, staff-level at multiple companies) with strong full-stack, distributed-systems, and testing/engineering-excellence credentials, plus mentoring and workshop delivery that maps well to the customer-facing and mentorship parts of the role. However, the core requirement of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions is not met: AI/GenAI exposure appears limited to roughly one year at re:cinq on MCP code generators and agentic tooling. The resume shows no Python, no vector databases or RAG architectures, no LLM evaluation/observability work, and only modest cloud depth (AWS CDK). Worth a conversation given the MCP and agent-infrastructure work and rapid-learning track record, but he would be a stretch hire against staff-level GenAI expectations.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production software, including staff-level and founder roles
Hands-on MCP and agentic-workflow tooling experience at re:cinq
Strong TypeScript/Node, testing, CI/CD, and mentoring/teaching track record
concerns: Only ~1 year of AI/GenAI work vs. 8+ years required
No evidence of Python, vector databases, or RAG architectures
Limited cloud-platform AI/data-pipeline depth; no LLM evaluation or observability work

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG, vector DB, and Python skills
Senior/staff engineering breadth, MCP work, and mentoring
